WITH a AS (SELECT geometry FROM read_parquet('divisions_area') WHERE id = 'a04bdea5-117e-475b-9d18-a2676796bd06') SELECT b.id, b.names."primary" AS name, b.subtype, ST_Area(b.geometry) AS area, ST_AsGeoJSON(b.geometry) AS geometry FROM read_parquet('divisions_area') AS b, a WHERE b.id != 'a04bdea5-117e-475b-9d18-a2676796bd06' AND b.subtype = 'county' AND ST_Within(b.geometry, a.geometry) ORDER BY area ASC LIMIT 3
